# Compatibility fixtures

Captured on 2026-11-02 from preserved pre-roadmap version-1 summaries and the original
version-1 share-preview PNG. JSON device identity is anonymized; original benchmark
IDs, workload metadata, values and statistics are retained. The PNG is the synthetic
preview fixture generated before selected-only export was introduced. These fixtures
exercise reading and display adaptation; they do not claim old/new kernel equivalence.
